sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time (UTC): 2026-10-28 01:42 UTC; Scope: Daily; Date range: 2026-10-28 through 2026-10-28; Ranking basis: GitHub Trending daily star gains, plus one separately labeled newly created repository from GitHub Search.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: AI-assisted interface design is today's clearest breakout: Hallmark, Impeccable, and AI Design Skills are all gaining quickly by packaging visual judgment as reusable agent workflows and checks. A second cluster is turning coding agents into persistent, multi-agent workspaces, while DeepTutor, Postiz, and Digital Human Koubo show agents moving into specific end-user jobs.

sections.title: Top Repositories
sections.content: Ten non-noise repositories from GitHub Trending are ranked by displayed daily star gains; one newly created repository from a two-day GitHub Search query is appended as a supplemental signal with no daily gain claimed.

sections.title: Nutlope/hallmark
sections.description: Design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode that pairs a theme catalog with browser-based quality gates.
sections.why_notable: Largest daily gain in this snapshot; its 50 visual themes and layered lint/review workflow make design quality actionable rather than prompt-only.

sections.title: HKUDS/DeepTutor
sections.description: Personalized AI tutoring system with study, document, and research workflows.
sections.why_notable: Strongest non-design daily mover, representing a move from general chat toward a persistent learning product.

sections.title: makecindy/cindy
sections.description: Open-source AI agent connecting computers and phone, existing coding harnesses, and user tools.
sections.why_notable: Combines multi-device continuity with Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, reflecting demand for agents that persist beyond a single editor session.

sections.title: pbakaus/impeccable
sections.description: Design guidance, commands, and deterministic checks for AI coding agents.
sections.why_notable: Its 62 deterministic frontend detector rules complement Hallmark's design workflow and reinforce the day's agent-design quality signal.

sections.title: elayadesign/ai-design-skills
sections.description: A small, installable collection of design skills for AI coding tools.
sections.why_notable: Another high-velocity design-skill repository; its README currently lists a landing-page skill and supports multiple coding harnesses.

sections.title: JetBrains/thinkrail
sections.description: Agentic IDE built around isolated workspaces, living specifications, and reusable skills.
sections.why_notable: A major IDE vendor's incubator project puts agent sessions inside a real workbench with git-worktree isolation and project knowledge that persists.

sections.title: affaan-m/ECC
sections.description: Agent-harness optimization system spanning skills, memory, security, and research-first development.
sections.why_notable: Cross-harness packaging and a broad tooling footprint show continued appetite for reusable operating layers around coding agents.

sections.title: gitroomhq/postiz-app
sections.description: Open-source social-media management platform for scheduling, automating, and analyzing content.
sections.why_notable: A practical non-coding-agent application, with self-hosting and integrations for social channels and AI agents.

sections.title: nightly-labs/openbot
sections.description: Local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates, queues, browser control, and collaboration.
sections.why_notable: Brings several model providers into persistent local workspaces with queues and agent collaboration.
sections.unique_caveat: README labels this a development preview; agents currently run with broad access after explicit first-launch consent.

sections.title: obra/superpowers
sections.description: Composable skills and a software-development methodology for coding agents.
sections.why_notable: Largest established project in the list by total stars, with a spec-to-plan-to-subagent workflow and broad harness support.

sections.title: andyhuo520/digital-human-koubo
sections.description: Agent skill for AI digital-human video production, from a photo and short brief to edited, captioned output.
sections.why_notable: Supplemental new-repository signal: created 2026-10-26 and found in the two-day GitHub Search window; README documents cost approval, segment checks, and creator-style packaging.
sections.unique_caveat: Not present in the daily Trending ranking; no comparable daily star-gain figure is available.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Design systems and quality checks for AI-generated interfaces: Hallmark, Impeccable, and AI Design Skills package visual direction, reusable skills, and checks; ThinkRail adds a workbench perspective. Persistent agent workspaces and orchestration: Cindy, OpenBot, and ThinkRail emphasize multi-device or isolated project contexts; ECC and Superpowers provide harness layers and execution methods. Task-specific AI products: DeepTutor targets personalized learning, Postiz social publishing, and Digital Human Koubo video production. TypeScript is the most common primary language (5 of 11); CSS, Python, Rust, JavaScript, and Shell each occur once; GitHub reports no primary language for AI Design Skills.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The day's strongest momentum is not for a single foundation model, but for structured layers that make agents produce more reliable work: design constraints, persistent context, isolated execution, and domain-specific workflows. The especially high design-skill gains suggest that polishing agent output is becoming a distinct developer-tool category, while practical products are extending that pattern beyond coding.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary source: https://github.com/trending?since=daily, accessed 2026-10-28 01:42 UTC. Corroboration: GitHub REST API repository metadata and current default-branch commits for each listed repository; GitHub Search API query created:>=2026-10-26 stars:>400 fork:false, sorted by stars, 8 matches. Leading theme representatives and the supplemental repository were checked against current README files and first-party docs. Daily gains are partial-day values. One two-day-search repo is appended as a supplemental entry with no daily gain claimed. The jailbreak list repository was excluded as off-topic noise. No prior-window comparison was available, so Notable Shifts is omitted.
